metadata.description: Update the schema for a specific object type within a given app.
metadata.learn_more: Update the schema for a specific object type within a given app. This operation allows you to modify the existing schema details, which can be useful for adapting to changes in data structure requirements or business logic.

appId.label: App Id
appId.description: The unique identifier of the app associated with the schema.

objectType.label: Object Type
objectType.description: The type of object whose schema is being updated.

allowsSensitiveProperties.label: Allows Sensitive Properties
allowsSensitiveProperties.description: A boolean that specifies if the object type allows properties marked as sensitive.

clearDescription.label: Clear Description
clearDescription.description: A boolean indicating whether the description should be cleared or reset.

description.label: Description
description.description: A string providing a description of the object type.

plural.label: Plural
plural.description: The plural label for the object type, used to represent multiple instances of the object. It is a string.

singular.label: Singular
singular.description: The singular label for the object type, used to represent a single instance of the object. It is a string.

primaryDisplayProperty.label: Primary Display Property
primaryDisplayProperty.description: A string that identifies the primary property used for displaying the object.

requiredProperties.label: Required Properties
requiredProperties.description: An array of strings indicating which properties are required for the object type.

restorable.label: Restorable
restorable.description: A boolean indicating whether the object type can be restored after deletion.

searchableProperties.label: Searchable Properties
searchableProperties.description: An array of strings specifying which properties can be used in search queries.

secondaryDisplayProperties.label: Secondary Display Properties
secondaryDisplayProperties.description: An array of strings that list additional properties used for displaying the object.
